description:
Calculate the Luminous Intensity (Candela) for a light source with 4500 Lumens and a 36-degree beam angle.

1. Open the Electrical Engineering Calculations app.
2. Navigate to the 'Lighting' section and open the 'Lumens - Candela' calculator.
3. Enter 4500 Lumens and 36 degrees.
4. Calculate the result.
5. Save a screenshot of the result to '/sdcard/tasks/lumens_to_candela/screenshot.png'.
6. Save the numeric result (rounded to nearest whole number) to '/sdcard/tasks/lumens_to_candela/result.txt'.
